name: B10-0055/2025 (Renew) – Need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the EU and other countries to reject Belarus's presidential election on 26 January 2025 as a sham and not recognise Aliaksandr Lukashenka as president afterwards. It asks for the release of all political prisoners, for sanctions to be tightened and loopholes closed, and for those responsible for repression to be investigated, including through the International Criminal Court. It also asks the EU to support Belarusians who have fled and the democratic opposition.

- The EU and member states are urged to reject the election result and Lukashenka's legitimacy.
- Sanctions should be widened and loopholes closed; EU firms are asked to leave Belarus.
- Political prisoners should be freed; exiled Belarusians should get visas, support and protection.
